thread:
maria_support: FYI customer FinEdge (ticket #2467) reporting a big p99 regression after our int8 quant profile rollout in eu-west-1 last night. p95 ~350ms -> p99 ~1.8s. They pinned model redwood/gptv2-3b@v42 (quant=int8). Can we triage?

sam_ml: Thanks — looking at telemetry. p95 stable but p99 spike concentrated on requests with seq_len >= 512. Suspect calibration mismatch or CPU fallback for some attention kernels. Can you paste the raw log lines?

maria_support: Pasted logs below from the customer:
```
[2026-03-17T03:12:09Z] request_id=R-55fa latency=1840ms model=redwood/gptv2-3b quant=int8 kernel=fallback_fp16 reason="calibration_mismatch"
[2026-03-17T03:12:09Z] warn: attention_kernel: no quant backend for seq_len=512 -> software dequant
```

kai_infra: I checked the infra metrics for eu-west-1; host eu-west-1-gpu-4 shows elevated CPU during those requests while GPU util stays ~60%. That pattern matches dequant happening on CPU (slow path). Looks like KV cache layout mismatch between compiled kernels and runtime layout for some seq lengths.

maria_support: Customer repro steps: 1) POST /v1/generate with payload {"input":"<~512 tokens>", "stream":false} 2) model pinned to redwood/gptv2-3b@v42 3) batch_size=1, max_new_tokens=256. They ran:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
 -d '{"model":"redwood/gptv2-3b@v42","input":"<big prompt>","max_new_tokens":256}'
```

sam_ml: Immediate mitigation options: - Toggle fallback-to-fp16 for this org (fast, low-risk) - Roll back the quant profile for v42 to the previous fp16 build - Enable deploy-time "quant_calibration_strict" to reject mismatched quant deploys. I'll kick off a canary rollback to fp16 for the org.

olivia_prod: Agreed. We can also set a routing rule so FinEdge's traffic hits the fp16 pool until we confirm fixes. Example admin command:
```
redwoodctl route --org finedge set --model redwood/gptv2-3b --target=fp16_pool
```

kai_infra: I'm temporarily bumping autoscaler for eu-west-1 to soak the extra CPU while we rollback: autoscale.min=6 -> 10 for 30m (will revert automatically). Patch pushed. infra-bot: announce autoscale change.

infra-bot: autoscale config updated (change_id=cfg-9134). Routing rule applied for org=finedge.

maria_support: I asked the customer to hit the endpoint with `?quant=fp16` and share new p99 numbers. Also attached the logs and the rollback notes to ticket #2467.

sam_ml: Long term: we need deploy-time calibration validation and a p99-based automated rollback for quant profile changes. I'll open an RFC and link it here: https://go/repo/rfcs/quant-calibration (placeholder). Also propose an alert that surfaces any "kernel=fallback_fp16" warnings aggregated by org.

olivia_prod: Add that alert and make it high-severity if it persists >5m or impacts >0.5% of requests for an org.

maria_support: Thanks everyone — updating ticket #2467 with mitigation steps and ETA. Assigning follow-up to sam_ml for RFC and long-term remediation. :thumbsup:
